eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 3:04 PM on AUG 21, 2021 Effective until 3:04 PM AUG 22, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a Mandatory Evacuation order for Frenchman Road near Bloomer Lake Road, north to the county line, and the Plumas side of Doyle Grade, due to a wildfire. You should leave the area immediately. If you remain, emergency personnel may not be able to help you. An evacuation center is set up at Veterans Memorial Hall in Portola, and Springs of Hope Church in Quincy. To view your evacuation zone, go to community.zonehaven.com.
